title: First run
description: The project files, what Run does, and where results appear.

steps.label: Files
steps.title: The three project files
steps.body: `schema.ts` defines the tables, `seed.ts` inserts the data, and `query.ts` runs the queries. Each file has a tab above the editor.

meta.summary: `schema.ts` defines tables, `seed.ts` inserts data, `query.ts` runs queries.

steps.label: Run
steps.title: Run the project
steps.body: Each run starts from a **fresh database**: it creates the tables from `schema.ts`, fills them with `seed.ts`, then runs `query.ts`.

meta.summary: The query returns the seeded users.
meta.changed: Ada and Grace are inserted by `seed.ts`. Each `$.display` call in `query.ts` adds a result card.

steps.label: Filter
steps.title: Filter the users
steps.body: This step adds a `where` clause that keeps the users whose name starts with A. Press **Run** to compare the result.
